summary: Iter253 — Full validation of Ads V2 Phase 1 auto-reconcile feature (Mezan demand #1). Backend: 21/22 pytest passing (1 skipped — no snap/tiktok accounts on test user). 6 new auto-reconcile tests + 4 invariant tests confirm SSOT preservation, no GL writes, no V1 mutation, ads_sync_logs event correctness, and proper match_status computation. Frontend: All Arabic UI labels render correctly, new 5-card legend (4/2/1/0/0), new blue 'إعادة المطابقة من المنصات' button, 6 new columns (الحالة / قيمة المنصة الآن / الفرق (SAR) / سبب الفرق / آخر مزامنة / آخر فحص للمنصة), 7 colored emoji badges in table, manual button correctly labeled 'إدخال يدوي (احتياطي)'. Stat cards retain text-3xl bold tabular-nums on dark background.

minor.issue: Test was skipped because no Snapchat/TikTok accounts are sync_enabled for the test user — code path for token_invalid → sync_failed (instead of 500) is implemented in core.py auto_reconcile_for_day() but not live-validated. Confirmed by code review in /app/backend/ads_v2/sync/core.py L716-728 (token-missing branch sets match_status='sync_failed' and returns ok=False without raising).

issues: A small inline code-style label 'ads_daily' is rendered as part of the SSOT explanation. This is a system identifier (acceptable per problem statement: 'Meta/Snapchat/TikTok platform names are allowed') but consider replacing with Arabic phrase like 'النظام' for full Arabic consistency.

critical_code_review_comments: auto_reconcile_for_day() in /app/backend/ads_v2/sync/core.py correctly preserves SSOT: only writes platform_authoritative_*, diff_*, drift_pct_vs_platform, match_status and never touches spend_native — verified by test_auto_reconcile_single_day_does_not_modify_spend_native (PASS).

_compute_match_status() handles all 5 branches correctly with correct priority (sync_failed > no_data > drift_review > pending_platform > matched) — verified by test_compute_match_status_all_branches (PASS).
Phase 2 boundary holds: 0 general_ledger entries with source=ads_v2 after auto-reconcile, 0 ads_daily rows with ledger_txn_group_id set.
ads_sync_logs.reconciliation_checked event captures platform_native, ssot_native, diff_native, diff_sar, match_status, actor email — full audit trail intact.

Cross-provider dispatcher: same auto_reconcile_user() loops over enabled accounts regardless of provider (Meta/Snapchat/TikTok), and token-missing path correctly degrades to match_status='sync_failed' rather than throwing 500.

FRONTEND: Default tab is recon ✓, blue 'إعادة المطابقة من المنصات' button placed next to green 'مزامنة الفترة الآن' ✓, 5-card legend with counts 4/2/1/0/0 sums to 7 matching 7 table rows ✓, manual button label demoted to 'إدخال يدوي (احتياطي)' ✓.
